reviews.text:
I reached out to Dr. Rice to help with Underdawg's allergies. Her application process truly impressed me, ensuring we were a good fit for each other.

From the moment Dr. Rice entered our home Underdawg (and I) loved her. She was professional, calming, and extremely knowledgeable. Underdawg immediately felt comfortable with her. I look forward to having her on Underdawg's care team.

Longshawt cant wait to get one on one time with Dr. Rice, stay tuned...

Dr. Rice is truly the best. She is kind, compassionate, patient, and incredibly knowledgeable. She always takes the time to thoroughly explain everything to us and does extra research when needed to make sure our pets are getting the best possible care. She never makes appointments feel rushed, and it’s obvious how deeply she cares about her patients (and their families!!). We always feel heard, informed, and reassured, and we’re so grateful to have her as our veterinarian!!

This review is long overdue but time has not changed my opinion at all. As veterinarians, we often need support and perspective when we are trying to treat our own animals. Dr. Holly Rice is that friend and colleague to me. She is insightful, patient, kind, and so helpful not just as a healthcare provider and consultant for my pets but as a person who cares about the owners of her patients as well. I’m honored and lucky to have her as a veterinarian friend to support and care for my pets as she would her very own.

Dr. Rice is kind, compassionate and knowledgeable. She treated my dog Rambo and my cat Ruby as one of her own. We have been monitoring Rambo's Valley Fever and Ruby's hyperthyroidism for the past several years. Ruby has always been scared at the vet's office and having Dr. Rice come to my home had made such a difference in her comfort!  Her expertise and care are unmatched and we are so lucky to have found her!

Dr. Rice has been caring for my pups for several years. She is compassionate, thorough and truly cares! She also has an amazing network of colleagues who specialize in different specialities such as PT and holistic practices. Since starting her own business, Dr. Rice is able to provide even more customized care and typically spends one hour with each of pups. I highly recommend her!

Doctor Rice is AMAZING! We have 4 dogs, 2 of which are incredibly anxious and hate going to the vet. Having Dr. Rice come to us and care for our pets has been such a great experience for them. The way she cares for our animals is like they are her own. Not only that, she will hear all of our concerns and explain what things could be connected and what we should focus on, what options we have for treatment, and what is best. She does not have the mindset that every dog is the same. Dr. Rice is kind, knowledgeable, and makes us feel comfortable with her assessments of our babies. I would absolutely recommend her to everyone.

Dr. Holly is amazing. She is so kind, compassionate and knowledgeable. I love that my dogs can be seen in their home environment…helps lower stress. Dr. Holly takes her time with each pet and goes through in detail what will help them be as healthy as possible. I HIGHLY recommend Dr. Woofs Veterinary Care and Dr. Holly!

We recently started using Dr. Woof’s Vet Care with Dr. Rice, and I’m so glad we did. I’ve known Dr. Rice as a veterinarian for a long time and have trusted her care with more than one dog over the years. She’s incredibly kind, practical, and thoughtful, and you can tell she genuinely wants the best outcome for the animal.

The in-home visit experience has been a huge plus—my dog was noticeably less stressed than with a traditional clinic visit, which makes the whole appointment smoother for everyone.

Dr. Rice is also very accommodating and easy to work with, and she takes the time to explain options in a clear, realistic way. If you’re considering a mobile vet, I highly recommend Dr. Woof’s Vet Care.

Dr Rice is the best! We have trusted her to take care of our dogs for many years. She now comes to your home! YAY! She takes all the time you need, answers all questions. The result is minimal stress for all concerned especially our fur baby. I highly recommend you try Dr Rice in home care.
Dr. Rice is an amazing mobile vet! She is kind, professional, and makes the whole visit easy and stress free. She clearly cares about my animals and takes great care of them. I highly recommend her!

If I could give a 10 Star review I would.  Dr. Rice is so knowledgeable, caring and wonderful with my fur baby.  Having her come to our home was so comfortable and less stressful for me and my pup. I highly recommend her.🩷🐶 …

I have not only worked with Dr Holly Rice in the past , she has also taken care of and will continue to take great care of my furbabies (dogs and kitties). Dr Rice is so kind and compassionate. She is an amazing  veterinarian and I highly trust and recommend her!

Dr. Holly is one of the most caring veterinarians I have ever encountered. I am so grateful for her and her service. She was very compassionate and caring when it came to helping my 16 year old dog, Rodeo, cross the rainbow bridge. I highly recommend her and her services.
Holly is the best! She is skilled, compassionate and convenient too!!! ♥️♥️♥️♥️♥️ Five hearts!
Thank you for your five star review!
Dr Rice is an amazing doctor!  She gives 150% of herself to every patient.  As a vet myself, I trust her with my own pets!

Dr. Rice truly goes above and beyond for my family. The compassion and love expressed with each visit reassures my wife and I that our pets are in safe hands. Thorough and attentive. She really listens and thats hard to find.
Dr. Rice goes above and beyond. Very compassionate towards all animals. Highly recommend!
Dr. Rice goes above and beyond for her clients and patients. Absolutely recommend!

Outstanding House Call Veterinarian - Highly Recommend!
As a holistic veterinarian, I'm extremely selective about who I trust with my own pets' care. Dr. Holly Rice is exceptional. She's intelligent, thorough, and shows genuine compassion for both animals and their humans.
Dr. Rice recently came to my home to examine my 2 new puppies and administer mercury-free rabies vaccines. The experience was wonderful - she was incredibly gentle with them, and they absolutely loved her (the treats helped too!). Her house call service eliminates the stress of a clinic visit, which makes such a difference.
I've personally worked with Dr. Holly Rice both as a colleague and a pet parent, and she has my utmost respect. I trust Dr. Rice completely with my pets' wellbeing. If you're looking for a knowledgeable, caring vet who truly puts your pet first, Dr. Holly Rice is the one to call.
Dr. Rice is wonderful!  Always compassionate and professional- you can tell how much she loves animals ❤️

Dr. Holly Rice is an excellent veterinarian. Her attention to detail and care for fur babies is top notch. She'll treat your pet and handle their care like her own and she puts much love into anything she does for them.

Dr. Rice is an amazing veterinarian. She loves her patients and her clients, she practices high quality medicine, and best of all she is comes to you. My babies are so much more comfortable in their own home and it makes the vet visits so much better for all of us.  Thank you Dr. Rice for all that you do!

We take feedback seriously, but in line with these other recent negative reviews, we cannot find any record of you as a customer. If you've had a genuine experience, please contact us directly so we can address it.
Bad experience!

I have known Dr. Rice for the past 20 years.   She is an extremely compassionate, empathetic and skilled veterinarian.    She has integrity and you can trust your pet’s care with her.  Congrats on your mobile practice.
I wouldn’t take my fur babies anywhere else! Holly is so sweet and compassionate.  Having her own practice was her best decision. Thank you Holly for you love and care!

Dr. Rice is the best! I used to work with her and know how much she truly loves and cares for animals. She treats every pet like family and takes the time to explain everything so you feel at ease. Knowledgeable, kind, and genuinely compassionate—your pets are in great hands with Dr. Rice!
Faith I appreciate your five-star review!
Dr. Rice is very caring and wonderful. I recommend her to anyone. :)
Dr Holly Rice is amazing & one of the most carings vets I’ve ever met. I’ve known her for many years & she is amazing with an amazing heart 🙌🏻😍🐾 …
BEST animal vet I know! She cares for your fur babies as if they were hers. Seeing is believing.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Dr. Rice.  My pets have only been treated with genuine kindness, patience, and professionalism. Dr. Rice takes the time to get to know her patients, not just medically, but personally - ensuring tails are wagging and faces smiling. .

Whether it is a routine check-up or something more stressful, her care is both thorough compassionate, obviously clearly rooted in deep expertise.

If you’re looking for a veterinarian who treats your loved pet like family and don’t want to fight traffic and drive across town to do so, Dr. Woof’s Veterinary Care is your veterinarian. Five stars isn’t enough!
Dr Holly is the best! I’ve gotten to know her over the years and I love just how she connects with the animals and us people too. Thanks for all you do! 🐾 …

Dr. Rice is truly amazing! She goes above and beyond for both pets and their people. You can tell right away how much she genuinely cares, not only about the animals but also about making owners feel comfortable and informed. She takes her time, answers every question with patience, and treats each pet as if they were her own.

I had a very disappointing experience with Dr. Holly Rice. She seemed disorganized and inattentive, which made the entire visit stressful for both me and my pet. The waiting time was excessively long despite having an appointment, and the clinic appeared unclean. The veterinarian seemed rushed and didn't take the time to fully address my concerns. Overall, I left feeling frustrated and worried about the quality of care provided. I would not recommend this clinic to other pet owners.

Dr. Holly Rice is the absolute best! She is incredibly thorough, compassionate and brilliant.  She puts all of the animals in her care at ease and really knows how to speak their language. If you haven't tried her services, then you are missing out on a premier veterinary experience! Call her now!
Your five-star review is much-appreciated Kristine!

Dr Rice is the consummate professional.  We were so happy to learn that she is now providing in home care. She goes out of her way to show compassion while providing needed care.  All 4 of our dogs think she is the "cat's meow."  Thank you for you kindness and expertise.  You are the best!
Dr. Rice is hands down the best Veterinarian we’ve ever used! Her compassion is incredible and she loves my pets like her own.

I'm beyond impressed with our new mobile vet! Dr. Rice came to our home and provided top-notch care for all 3 of my fur babies, despite their, shall we say, 'spirited' personalities. What truly set her apart was the ability to tailor her approach to each dog's unique needs and boundaries. She took the time to read our pups' tells and worked with us to ensure everyone - both human and canine - felt comfortable and at ease. No pushing or forcing, just gentle, understanding care. The convenience of having her come to us was a huge bonus as our 2 Belgian Malinois and chihuahua can be a bit of work to take to a facility. but the compassionate and individualized approach that really makes the service stand out. Highly recommend!
We take feedback seriously, but we cannot find any record of you as a customer. If you've had a genuine experience, please contact us directly so we can address it.
Dr. Rice is amazing and one of a kind. One of the sweetest and most caring people I have ever met. She cares about the animals and also us pet parents.

Holly is AMAZING!  Not only is she incredibly knowledgeable, she TRULY CARES. You can tell this is NOT just a job for her — she lives and breathes it.  When you need a vet for your pet, you’ll be so glad you picked Holly!

Dr. Rice is such an amazing vet and human being. I can’t recommend her enough. She is both kind and knowledgeable. Sometimes my dog has some “stranger danger” issues, but immediately loved Dr. Rice. I’m extremely cautious about who I recommend, but I’ve recommended her to all my friends and family!

Dr Rice has been a go to of ours for many years, has seen many of our animals in both routine and urgent situations, providing fantastic care putting the pet's best interest first and foremost. She explains situations clearly and thoughtfully, is empathetic to both the pet and owner, and leave you feeling like she's caring for a pet of her own.

Having the flexibility for in-home care is a great option given the busy times we live in. Our dogs and cats are always excited to see Dr Rice, a telltale sign of her caring approach to pet healthcare.

Holly is amazing, literally 1 of a kind. Over the yrs Holly has taken care of 3 of my cats and 4 of my dogs. Holly has the most amazing bedside manners, she actually cares and you can feel her love towards the animals and what she does.  Christmas Eve one yr Holly was by my side when it was time to say good bye.

I am extremely pleased with the care and knowledge provided by Dr. Rice. She is attentive and listens to my concerns. So wonderful to be able to have her come to my home where my pet is more comfortable!
Your five-star review is greatly appreciated Beth!

I am a pet professional and have a puppy training business. Dr. Rice is on my short list of veterinarians that not only do i recommend to my clients, I trust with own animals. She is smart, knowledgeable, and caring.
Dr.Holly is one of the few veterinarians that I trust fully with my pets. They’re always super excited to see her and I’m always impressed by the care Dr. Holly shows.

Dr. Rice is one of the most compassionate, understanding vets out there. She treats every animal as if they were her own. I have a large pack of dogs and she values getting to know each and every one of them. Her quality of care is outstanding!
this vet doesn’t care about animals in the manner she’s presenting.
Many thanks for your five-star review Jessica. This is the type of service we aim to provide.
Dr. Holly has done an amazing job with my pets and even holding my hand through it all. I highly recommend her and find her to be a skilled and knowledgable vet!
Would your account be under another name? We don't have any record of "pharaoh TakeOff" and would be happy to discuss how we can serve you and your pets better.
Very unprofessional and is a vet simply for the pay. Does not truly care about dogs like she claims.

My dogs LOVE Dr Woof! Dr Rice gives exceptional care. My beloved pups have zero stress being treated from home. They are very relaxed during the appointments. They know and feel the love and compassion Dr Rice has for them. Call and make your appointment today.

I am concerned that this review was placed on our page by mistake. We have no record of you using our in-home services and would appreciate the courtesy of you removing this review from our Google page. Thank you!

This was an amazing experience and was much easier to have the in home care rather than getting 3 dogs all over to a clinic. Dr. Rice was very informative and was happy to answer all the questions we had. Our dogs all felt much more at ease being in the comfort of our own home. She was very caring and detailed oriented in making sure our dogs were on good health.

Dr. Rice was gentle and patient with my nervous senior dog Luna. Luna always gets stressed going into a vets office so the at home care was perfect for her. Absolutely great appointment for my pup, highly recommend!

Dr. Rice is amazing. She was able to get us seen right away. I took my dog, Hazel, to Dr. Rice and she was very patient, kind and considerate of my concerns and my pet. After seeing Dr. Rice, Hazel is doing great with her mobility and off to a good start on her weight loss journey. Thank you Dr. Rice for being so kind to Hazel and I, we look forward to continuing our weight loss with you and we will definitely be back.

literally could not recommend Dr. Woof (Dr.
Holly Rice) more!!! She has taken care of our cats and dogs for years. The knowledge she has is beyond expectations but even more her compassion for not only the animals whom she loves so much but for the owners is unmatched. We have moved practices a few times just to be with her! She truly listens to the owners and the pets signs alike! She does not recommend unnecessary
treatments but professionally takes it step by step to give the animal the best care humanly possible. To our family she is an angel on earth (and our pets agree!) to now have her care in your own home is perfect! |
Dr Rice is one of the smartest, most caring vets I've met.  She's so knowledgeable about everything from puppy care to complex medical cases.  So glad that she's started her own practice!
Dr. Rice has been our vet and personal friend for many years. There isn't another hooman in the valley I'd allow to work with/on my babies. We love Holly!
